name: unreachable stale-segment isolated GC interruption and duplicate-retry result

A.recovery: fresh reread found same candidate blob; delete retry succeeded

B.retry_phase: fresh authority read; A missing treated as already-collected success; B still exact-match

design_revision.before: A stale segment was known to be unreferenced by the recomputed publication outcome, but current-tree reachability and orphan-GC retry had not been exercised together.
design_revision.after: For a bounded content-addressed role-local publication chain, GC eligibility can be derived from final-head reachability; deletion is safe only on isolated redundant copies after a fresh authority check. Missing-on-retry is success, and a live 409 requires reconciliation rather than blind mutation retry.

scope_limits: Current-tree reachability only; Git history retains deleted fixture copies.
Only isolated role-local text copies were deleted; the original stale segment was preserved.
Does not establish exactly-once semantics for opaque external effects or garbage collection of arbitrary repository objects.

quota_and_cost.transport: low-volume GitHub repository API with explicit conflict reconciliation
